entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏与官话栏均[残]，闽南音写 gaū ūn 两音皆污损（T99），西语残句 el otro para. 疑为上栏词条延续，语义无从定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉/官话栏均[残]，音写 chīn chīn 1. chō chō 四音全污损（T99）；西语 enrajar 疑为 17 世纪“平息、息怒”义，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 发怒；悲切、切齿怨恨（“切”取仄读怨切义）
entries.en: to get angry, take offense; to be grieved with keen resentment (qiè reading of 切)

entries.zh: 生气、赌气，争执不休（“激”取激动怄气义）
entries.en: to get angry and quarrel obstinately

entries.zh: 对他人生气、恼怒；忧愁怨愤
entries.en: to be angry with another; to be distressed and sullen
entries.notes: “憂”本义忧愁，原书以之对当 enojarse con otro，按原书直录。

entries.zh: 着愾，动怒、生起气来
entries.en: to get angry, fly into a temper
entries.notes: 第二字[疑:愾/恬]，按“愾”（怒气）释义。

entries.zh: 着惱，恼怒；怀恨、心存怨怼
entries.en: to be vexed, angered; to bear a grudge

entries.zh: 愾惱，含怒含恼、生气而怀怨
entries.en: to be angry with rancor

entries.zh: 愾起来，发起怒来、生起气来
entries.en: to fly into a temper, get worked up
entries.notes: 第三字[疑:耒/來]，按“起來”结构释义。

entries.zh: 怒氣，发怒、动怒气
entries.en: anger; to get angry, be in a rage

entries.zh: 生气动怒（字面“置兇”，确切语义存疑）
entries.en: to get angry (literal “set ferocity”; exact sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 首字[疑:置/罝]，官话栏 chȳ quoī 与“置兇”对音未获旁证，语义仅按原书直录。

entries.zh: 着切，动怒（“切”取怒切、恼怒义）
entries.en: to get angry, be vexed

entries.zh: 激促，被激恼而气急、又急又怒
entries.en: exasperated, provoked to anger and agitation

entries.zh: 恨氣，怀恨赌气、含怨发怒
entries.en: resentful anger; to be angry with rancor

entries.zh: 恨發，恨气发作、怒火爆发
entries.en: to burst out in anger, to fly into a rage

entries.zh: 忿恨，愤恨、忿怒怨恨
entries.en: indignation and hatred; resentful fury

entries.zh: 激氣，怄气、受激而怒
entries.en: to get worked up, be provoked to anger

entries.zh: 逞氣，负气使性、逞意气而怒
entries.en: to vent one's anger, indulge one's temper

entries.zh: 受氣，受气、受气恼怒
entries.en: to take offense, be angered by another

entries.zh: 愾氣，含怒生气
entries.en: anger, wrath; to be full of anger
entries.notes: 首字[疑:愾/恬]，按“愾”（怒气）释义。

entries.zh: 面向銃，怒形于色、面色骤变如铳发
entries.en: to get angry with a sudden change of countenance
entries.notes: “銃”本义火铳，此处对当 demudándose（变容），按原书直录，疑指怒容突变。

entries.zh: 面變，变脸变色、怒而色变
entries.en: to change countenance in anger

entries.zh: 怪恨，怨怪怀恨、怪罪而记恨
entries.en: to blame and bear a grudge
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部残缺（enojarse y tener en…），据存留部分与“怪恨”对当释义。
